report.summary: P-D006 (59, uninsured) needs med_cost and transport support. High-cost tiotropium ($420/month copay, 45-day refill gap) is the priority; albuterol and amlodipine are lower cost. Transportation is a confirmed barrier; tract has 41% no-vehicle households but strong transit density. Transit feasibility for appt:2 (10/23, 14:00) could not be computed (no facility location on file). Eligibility: Senior Shuttle (60+) and Medicaid Ride Line (Medicaid) not eligible due to age/coverage; ADA paratransit available but up to 21 days; clinic Rx Fund and pharmacy assistance/manufacturer programs are the best near-term med-cost options.

options.name: Clinic Rx Fund
options.how_to_access: Contact clinic for short-term copay assistance for current patients (tiotropium).

options.name: Community Pharmacy Assistance
options.how_to_access: Apply for Extra Help and manufacturer patient-assistance programs for brand tiotropium.

options.name: Rx Bridge Program
options.how_to_access: Review free/low-cost chronic illness medication options for tiotropium and albuterol.

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk (ADA paratransit)
options.how_to_access: Apply by phone for ADA paratransit certification; decisions take up to 21 days, so apply promptly for the 10/23 appointment.

options.name: Senior Shuttle West
options.how_to_access: Free weekday medical rides for adults 60+; patient is 59 and not currently eligible—re-evaluate at age 60.

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line
options.how_to_access: Medicaid plan members only; not eligible while uninsured unless coverage is obtained.
